# Assistant Emily: Lossless Markdown Proofreading & Context-Aware AI Translation for Obsidian

> Assistant Emily is a desktop Obsidian community plugin built natively around FreeLLMAPI as its primary AI proxy, with auxiliary support for local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It features a lossless syntax masking pipeline that guarantees zero destruction of Obsidian links, math, callouts, and frontmatter.

- Repository: https://github.com/sparklings/emily
- Documentation: https://github.com/sparklings/emily/tree/master/docs
- Wiki: https://github.com/sparklings/emily/wiki
- License: MIT
- Version: 1.1.2
- Primary Backend: FreeLLMAPI (https://api.freellmapi.com/v1)

## Core Capabilities
- Lossless Syntax Masking: 10-element UUID token taxonomy safeguarding Obsidian Flavored Markdown (OFM)
- Primary FreeLLMAPI Integration: 34+ providers, 635 endpoints, ~7.4B tokens/month
- Local Ollama & OpenAI-compatible support
- Selection and Full Document Translation with 1,800-character Smart Chunking
- Side-by-Side Proofreading Diff Modal with interactive line-by-line sync
